briefs.title: 光影纸面
briefs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished, high-fidelity mobile app homepage concept screenshot for Echooo, a personal photo-wall companion. This is a static design proposal, not a photograph of a phone. Canvas portrait 1080 x 2340 pixels, roughly 9:19.5; flat front view, edge-to-edge screen, NO phone body, NO desktop presentation board, NO surrounding margins. All three concepts in this series share September 15, 2026 as today's date. Chinese typography must be impeccable and sparse.
Product invariants: a persistent top utility row with a small green status dot and exact label "已连接" upper left; on the upper right exact label "偏好" followed by a separate simple outlined gear icon. These are peers, readable and restrained with generous touch area. No bottom tab bar, no floating toolbar, no hero CTA, no weather controls, no preference cards, no UI panel overlaying a wallpaper. No future photographs or upcoming display preview. Today is an intentionally empty yet beautiful day; actual imagery is only on clearly labeled earlier dates. A small fixed bottom text cue "向上滑，回看日子" is sufficient. Minimal iOS status bar 9:41 can sit above utilities.
The content is fictional concept imagery: Sept 13 is a quiet blue seaside afternoon, Sept 11 is a warm window-lit cafe moment. Do not depict a physical photo wall or frame device. Do not fabricate many other records. Text permitted: "已连接", "偏好", "回忆日历", "2026 / 09", "15", "今天", "14", "13", "11", "去看海", "窗边的午后", "向上滑，回看日子". Use only the subset needed, no extra slogans or English mockup labels. The homepage itself must look coherent, collectible and usable. No rounded floating photo cards, polaroids, stickers, clipart, purple gradients, sparkles, or generic dashboard structure. Prioritize memorable composition and refined hierarchy.
VISUAL DIRECTION A — LIGHT ON FOLDED PAPER.
Primary reference principle: light is material and perceived depth; architectural light art, adapted to functional calm page design. This is an ORIGINAL interface, no recreation of an existing artwork.
The whole screen is a single continuous sculptural sheet of very white fine uncoated paper, with three broad shallow horizontal folds receding and expanding as a vertical timeline. Light rakes across it from upper right, leaving one sharply beautiful diagonal shadow and soft ambient shadows inside each fold. Extraordinary photoreal material detail, subtle off-white versus cool gray; tiny touch of warm sunlight, no tan/cream vintage stationery aesthetic. The paper is the structure, NOT a background beneath UI cards.
Under the restrained top utility row, small "回忆日历" at left and "2026 / 09" at right. First wide empty folded surface carries a quiet embossed "15" and small "今天" at its left edge, NOT a huge hero numeral. The narrow following fold is "14". The third, much larger surface is "13", opening into a full-width blue sea image seemingly pigment-printed INTO the white sheet itself, a very beautiful photographic tide washing around a pale rock, integrated smoothly with the paper at one edge. That image occupies the lower-middle third of the screen; it has NO rectangle border, NO raised card, NO tilt. A small "去看海" annotation is sharply printed on the same surface. At bottom just a hint of the next paper layer "11". Maintain strong typographic contrast despite light shadows, a single elegant modern sans family, generous empty space, quiet asymmetry. All fold surfaces touch each other as one uninterrupted object. The shot is a refined app screen with strong art direction, not a blank poster and not a physical calendar photographed on a desk.

No rounded floating photo cards, polaroids, stickers, clipart, purple gradients, sparkles, or generic dashboard structure. Prioritize memorable composition and refined hierarchy.
VISUAL DIRECTION B — A PERSONAL TEXTILE OF DAYS.
Primary reference principle: finely woven abstract textile composition, rich figure-ground relationships and rhythmic changes in weave as carriers of time. An ORIGINAL composition, not a reproduction of a textile artwork.
The interface surface is one continuous breathtaking piece of finely woven contemporary textile filling the main canvas. Close enough to see individual fibers but polished and small scale, not a coarse rug. Tightly controlled luminous flax, deep ink blue, muted oxidized copper, dusty rose, and a few precise black thread lines. The cloth's uninterrupted vertical extent IS the date timeline. It must have sculptural/tactile beauty and bold color-block rhythm, not a fabric texture under photo cards and not a generic heatmap. No separate framed images anywhere.
Top header is an unpatterned light linen selvedge with quiet black utility labels. Beneath it small "回忆日历", modest "2026 / 09". At top of the woven field the newest date "15" with "今天" is an open light warp, a calm unfinished passage. Earlier "14" is a narrow neutral weave. The much wider "13" section shifts into an abstracted recognizable seascape woven directly into threads: blue water, pale sand, one dark coastal accent. Its shapes are made by the same fabric, NOT a photo pasted on top. Below, "11" begins a rose-and-copper weave suggestive of warm cafe light. The color composition should feel like an individually composed artwork, with clear large shapes and restrained detailed rhythm, never rainbow, pixel mosaic, a busy patchwork quilt, or an ethnic pattern.
Dates are small crisp dark ink numbers set on a very narrow light selvedge running down the left edge, subtly aligned to each band so this is unmistakably a scrollable calendar. The white margin is no more than 12% of width. The textile runs all the way to right edge and beyond lower viewport. Let the cloth have one very subtle raised fold/luminous thread highlight, no dramatic waves. Few elegant text elements remain perfectly legible. This direction must feel warm and personal, materially rich, unmistakably distinct from a paper calendar or landscape wallpaper.

No rounded floating photo cards, polaroids, stickers, clipart, purple gradients, sparkles, or generic dashboard structure. Prioritize memorable composition and refined hierarchy.
VISUAL DIRECTION C — AN UNFOLDING PHOTOGRAPHIC MEMORY.
Primary reference principle: image sequence makes time physically perceptible. Original contemporary photographic publication/cinema aesthetic, NOT a recreation of a film installation.
A deep charcoal, almost black screen with one continuous edge-to-edge vertical ribbon of exquisite natural-light photography. Photography and narrow dark inter-frame intervals ARE the entire scrolling layout. No cards, no picture frames, no polaroids, no dashboard boxes, no old-film sprocket holes or dated sepia nostalgia.
Top utility labels in crisp off-white with generous breathing room. "回忆日历" small at left, "2026 / 09" small at right. Today "15" with "今天" is a very short beautifully empty dark exposure band at the top of the ribbon, not a large empty hero. Immediately below is the earlier "13" date in a refined narrow dark rail aligned to the photo. The Sept 13 photograph fills roughly 55% of the entire screen: a candid cinematic seaside afternoon, deep yet natural blue sea, silver sunlight scattered on water, the edge of a young adult's shoulder/linen sleeve in foreground and another tiny distant figure in an otherwise spacious composition. Mature premium editorial photography, not stock travel scenery, no posed smiling portrait, no illustration. The image is allowed to reach the screen edge. The top boundary has a subtle luminous silver reveal as if exposure is settling, no fake blur across faces.
Below, an extremely narrow black inter-frame separator carrying "11" and small "窗边的午后", followed by the visible beginning of a second photograph: a still cup beside a sunlit cafe window, rich warm reflections. There is a sensual contrast between cool seaside and amber cafe, yet everything reads as the same continuous photographic ribbon, never separate cards. Use confident precise modern sans typography, film-credit restraint, thin date rule at the very left. Only one quiet "去看海" caption. The screen should feel emotionally immediate, quietly cinematic and mature. Photographs are concept samples of PAST records only; no unknown future preview. Avoid decorative animations represented with swirls or arrows. This is a static first frame that is already beautiful without motion.
